question: What is the subunits composition of prokaryotic ribosomes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**50S and 30S.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subunits composition of **prokaryotic ribosomes** is **50S and 30S.**
 
• The 50S subunit comprises of **34 proteins and 2 ribosomal RNA (rRNA) molecules **- 23S and 5S rRNA.
 
• The 30S subunit comprises of **21 proteins and 1 rRNA molecule** - 16S rRNA.
 
• These subunits combine to form a **functional 70S ribosome** in prokaryotes.
 
• The ribosome is responsible for** protein synthesis** in the cell.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 50S and 40S subunits are present in **eukaryotic ribosomes**.

 
 
• The 50S subunit in eukaryotes comprises of **49 proteins** and** 2 rRNA molecules -** 28S, 5.8S and 5S rRNA.
 
• The **40S** subunit comprises of **33 proteins and 1 rRNA molecule** - 18S rRNA.
 
 
 
• 60S and 30S subunits are present in** mitochondrial ribosomes**.
 
 
• The 60S subunit in mitochondria comprises of **49 proteins and 2 rRNA** molecules - 16S and 12S rRNA.
 
• The 30S subunit comprises o**f 33 proteins and 1 rRNA molecule** - 21S rRNA.
 
 
 
• 60S and 40S subunits are present in **eukaryotic ribosomes.**
